item.title: Apple’s Smart Home Push Includes Doorbell, Lock, Thermostat Codeveloped With LG
item.description: Apple Inc.’s upcoming push into smart home devices will include a doorbell, thermostat and other accessories developed through an unusual partnership with LG Electronics Inc.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gurman

item.title: Open-Source AI Tools Are Problem for Stopping Child Predators
item.description: Once the models are downloaded, illegal acts are almost impossible to track.
item.dc:creator: Kurt Wagner and Jordan Robertson

item.title: Investor 'Floodgates' Opened For IBIT ETF: BlackRock's Jacobs
item.description: Jay Jacobs, US head of equity ETFs BlackRock, joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss the attractiveness of the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (ticker: IBIT) to investor portfolios. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bitcoin Becoming Portfolio Allocation: BlackRock's Jacobs
item.description: Jay Jacobs, US head of equity ETFs BlackRock, joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss the attractiveness of the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (ticker: IBIT) to investor portfolios. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: RBA Frets Potential AI Stock Slump Could Hit Australian Spending
item.description: Australian households have significant exposure to artificial-intelligence stocks, leaving consumer spending and the broader economy vulnerable to a sharp correction, according to internal Reserve Bank documents.
item.dc:creator: Michael Heath

item.title: Tracking Stablecoin Supply, Circulation
item.description: On "Bloomberg Crypto" Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat discuss the new Bloomberg function RWAS that tracks the circulation and supply of stablecoin. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Global Situation Room Issues AI Reputation Risk Warning
item.description: Isabel Guzman, chair of the Risk Advisory Council for Global Situation Room, said that misuse of AI poses reputational risks to companies as AI poses accelerated hazards around fraud and misconduct for consumers. Guzman said that while customers enjoy online advances in the financial services sector, they still want to be able to pivot to a live human to help with banking. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bitcoin Headwinds Are Sign of Monetary Tightening: Acheson
item.description: Jay Jacobs, US head of equity ETFs BlackRock, joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss the attractiveness of the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (ticker: IBIT) to investor portfolios. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Waymo Boosts Private Debt Deal to $5 Billion in Push for Growth
item.description: Waymo increased the size of its inaugural debt raise to $5 billion, tapping lenders to help fuel the robotaxi company’s growth as it expands globally.
item.dc:creator: Paula Seligson and Carmen Arroyo

item.title: Anthropic Expands Access to Latest AI Models for Cyber Firms
item.description: Anthropic PBC is expanding access to its most advanced AI models, allowing a select group of organizations to test the startup’s cutting-edge cyber capabilities in collaboration with the US government.
item.dc:creator: Patrick Howell O'Neill

item.title: Billions Pour Into OpenAI, DeepSeek Ahead of IPOs
item.description: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down OpenAI's talks with multiple investors to raise at least $30 billion at a valuation of about $1.4 trillion. Plus, DeepSeek is also close to securing at least $12 billion in funding ahead of its own IPO next year, and JPMorganChase CEO Jamie Dimon weighs in on data centers and AI risks from London's Tech Stars event. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: CFTC, SEC Put 'Some Wind' Into Early VC Stage: Ross
item.description: Alex Ross, managing partner of Illuminate Financial, joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss the current climate for crypto venture capital. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: This Is The Moment For Crypto Rules: Kristin Smith
item.description: Kristin Smith, president of Solana Policy Institute and incoming interim CEO of Blockchain Association, joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss the urgency for the crypto industry to establish rules in the current favorable DC political environment. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: CFTC Proposes Registering Crypto Exchanges Offering Leverage
item.description: Bloomberg's Lydia Beyoud joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." The CFTC unveiled a proposal Monday to regulate digital asset transactions and markets, drawing on the agency’s existing authority after crypto market structure legislation was blocked last month. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Horse Has Left Barn, Equities Will Be On-Chain: Cagney
item.description: Mike Cagney, co-founder and executive chairman of Figure, joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss the potential for blockchain and the latest funding round for his new company Navra. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: OpenAI, Anthropic Lead Consumer AI Spending: A16z
item.description: Andreessen Horowitz partner Olivia Moore says consumer AI adoption is growing, but fewer than 5% of consumers are paying for even one AI product. She discusses why OpenAI and Anthropic dominate spending, with a small group of power users paying as much as $1,000 a month, and why AI’s next consumer opportunity could come from new business models and categories beyond productivity - including social, entertainment, health and other “multiplayer” experiences. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Pimco Sees Three Buffers Supporting US Economic Resilience
item.description: Pimco Economist Tiffany Wilding discusses findings of the firm’s annual cyclical outlook. The report points to the key buffers for the US economy, booming investment in AI, the ability of consumers to absorb higher costs, and an incremental approach to monetary policy. She speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Anthropic, OpenAI Can Both Win AI Race: T. Rowe Price
item.description: T. Rowe Price partner Emma Norchet says Anthropic is entering “act two” of its growth story, moving beyond its early success in coding toward becoming an AI layer through which businesses can execute entire workflows. With multi-billion-dollar positions in both Anthropic and OpenAI, Norchet explains why T. Rowe Price doesn’t see frontier AI as a winner-take-all market. Norchet discusses where she sees the next opportunities for Anthropic, and why public-market investors will have an appetite for leading AI companies when they choose to IPO. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bender: AI’s ‘Existential’ Risk Is ‘Fake’
item.description: University of Washington professor Emily Bender argues the AI safety debate is too focused on hypothetical existential threats while overlooking harms already happening today. She points to environmental costs, disruption to workers, surveillance, misinformation and chatbot dependence. She argues that incidents involving AI systems accessing outside networks should be viewed as the responsibility of the companies deploying them - not as autonomous models “going rogue.” She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI Startup Hark Debuts 'Proactive' Hark Pro App Ahead of 2027 Hardware Launch
item.description: Entrepreneur Brett Adcock’s artificial intelligence-focused hardware startup, Hark, introduced a new “proactive” AI app ahead of launching its first devices next year.
item.dc:creator: Samantha Kelly
